profile.headline: Software Engineer at Cognizant
profile.geoLocationName: Cherry Hill, New Jersey, United States
profile.summary:
Software/Sales Specialist with over 12 years of combined experience in Sales, Customer Service, Management and Information Technology. 

Having worked with people my entire career, I've developed a strong ability to solve problems in creative ways, whether through sales, management, or technology. I now look to build off of my previous experiences to help individuals and businesses succeed in ways that have a lasting positive impact.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · Remote
positions.description: Software Engineer at Cognizant. Utilize agile methodologies to gather accurate requirements for application development, maintaining consistent communication with clients. Primarily utilizing AWS services for Mobile Application development, including AWS Lambda, API Gateway, CloudWatch and DynamoDB. Additional technologies used include Java, Spring, Maven, JavaScript, React, Node.js, Postgresql, MongoDB, Docker, Pivotal Cloud Foundry, RabbitMQ, ELK, Git, Github.
positions.insights: Skills: Mobile Application Development · DevOps · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · React Native · Github · JavaScript · Node.js

positions.title: Freelance Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
Recent Projects:

VA Web App
Worked on a portfolio site for a voice actor to showcase their work, and share contact information for potential opportunities. Technologies used include HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, jQuery and Bootstrap.

Photographer Website
Working with a photographer who is looking to increase their exposure and business with an online presence. Currently using React, HTML5 and CSS3.

TruckSource Truck Rental Service App
Mobile application, working with a startup company looking to simplify the truck rental process for local businesses. Currently in prototyping stage for iOS using Swift 3.
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · React Native · Github · JavaScript · Node.js

positions.title: Software Engineer / Rental Manager
positions.description:
- Implemented React component-based architecture for company site redesign, improving network efficiency and providing faster access to product information 
- Developed React-Native mobile application utilizing mobile-first principles to provide minimal app rerendering and optimal rendering across multiple devices 
- Rebuilt vehicle database using SQL to improve application and company access 
- Designed and maintained Salesforce standard and custom objects to significantly improve customer tracking and rental processing
positions.insights: Skills: React Native · Github · JavaScript · Node.js

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
- Integrated React and Redux to build out user functionality and improve user authentication flow
- Collaborated with other frontend developers to optimize the user experience
- Received mentorship from backend engineers and assisted in backend functionality
- Utilized Git for source control

positions.title: Personal Banker
positions.description:
- Utilized custom CRM platform to provide improved customer service and referral opportunities
- Provided detailed walkthroughs for customers on updates to mobile and online banking services
- Consulted clients on products and services that best met their financial needs 
- Partnered with additional lines of business to provide a complete banking resource 
- Regularly followed up with clients to earn continued business and provide troubleshooting
- Consistently stayed updated on current banking standards and regulations, taking advantage of any opportunities to test out new technologies

projects.title: Apparel Shopping App
projects.description: Discussed basic design options with client, which are reflected in current version of the app. Uses a React and Bootstrap frontend, with plans to add an apparel database with MongoDB. It is a work in progress as other aspects of the business are completed.

projects.title: You-Torial
projects.description: You-Torial is a responsive, full CRUD app serving as a collection of online development tutorials. Users provide ratings/reviews to lessen time-consuming searches. Technologies used: React, Node, Express
